claims: Chuck Norris passed away on March 20, 2026.
Chuck Norris was 86 years old at the time of his passing.
Chuck Norris had a widely estimated net worth of $70 million at the time of his passing in March 2026.
Chuck Norris was an American martial artist and actor.
Walker, Texas Ranger ran from 1993 to 2001.
Walker, Texas Ranger ran for eight seasons.
Walker, Texas Ranger generated over $692 million in revenue through syndication and licensing.
Walker, Texas Ranger was the primary source of Chuck Norris's wealth.
Chuck Norris was the star of Walker, Texas Ranger.
Chuck Norris was the executive producer of Walker, Texas Ranger.
Chuck Norris secured a significant ownership stake in Walker, Texas Ranger.
Chuck Norris starred in Missing in Action.
Chuck Norris starred in The Delta Force.
Chuck Norris starred in The Way of the Dragon.
Chuck Norris was known for long-running commercials for the Total Gym line of exercise equipment.
Chuck Norris created his own proprietary fighting system called Chun Kuk Do.
Chuck Norris built a business empire based on his martial arts training schools.
Chuck Norris maintained a ranch in Texas.
Chuck Norris maintained a home on Kauai's North Shore.
Chuck Norris's philanthropy included the Kickstart Kids program.
